svg.title: Same spend. More tasks solved.
svg.desc: In a small internal pilot with one model, a solved task cost about 4.8 cents without memory and 1.1 cents with relevant Vexen memory, because the cost per run was about the same and more runs succeeded. A check adds at most 1,800 bytes, roughly 450 tokens. Twenty runs per group, synthetic tasks, not a general cost-saving claim.
